en.title: OAuth 2.1 draft: is SHOULD in §3.2.3 intended where RFC 9700 Section 4.14.2 says MUST?
en.summary: RFC 9700 Section 4.14.2 requires authorization servers to decide, based on a risk assessment, whether to issue refresh tokens to a client (MUST). §3.2.3 of the draft repeats the sentence with SHOULD, and the -05 entry of the document history says the refresh token guidance was updated to match the security best practice. The text does not say whether the lower level is intended.
en.impact: An authorization server that issues refresh tokens without a risk assessment conforms to the draft and breaks RFC 9700.
en.correction: Use MUST in §3.2.3, or add a note that the lower level is intended.
